No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this discussion you design heritage activities around consent, benefit and local knowledge.

It is run as a guided conversation, online or on your campus, and works best with a group that is ready to argue a point.

What it covers

  • Stakeholder listening exercise
  • Community partnership case
  • Shared benefit planning
  • Participant project brief

How the time is spent

  1. Stakeholder listening exercise 15 min

  2. Community partnership case 30 min

  3. Shared benefit planning 35 min

  4. Participant project brief 20 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Listen to stakeholders and identify the local knowledge a heritage activity should draw on.
  • Plan heritage activities around consent and shared benefit, using a community partnership case.
  • Draft a project brief for a heritage activity of your own.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
